name: io.github.deepa-wagent/wagent
title: Wagent
description: WhatsApp MCP server with per-chat permissions. Agents see only chats you allow; sends wait for you.

connection_id.description: The id in your agent's private link from app.wagent.sh (https://mcp.wagent.sh/c/<connection_id>/mcp). Sign-in is OAuth; you approve the agent with a code sent to your own WhatsApp.
